engine.status_note: Every cited file has an empty `git status --porcelain -- <file>` and a blob SHA resolved from HEAD. The worktree has 191 unrelated staged changes (mostly Flutter/config deletions), none touching the cited files.

anchors.contract: Legacy Default Lit deferred direct lighting: light geometry/attenuation, packed shadow terms, finite-source BRDF integral, scale, and split accumulation.
facts: GetLocalLightAttenuation (246-286) returns a scalar LightMask from inverse-square or RadialAttenuation, spot, and rect support.
MaskedLightColor *= LightMask at 337-338; the BRDF helper receives the unattenuated light data.
GetShadowTerms/GetShadowTermsBase (90-149) decodes LightAttenuation as X=whole-scene directional, Y=directional SSS, Z=light function/per-object, W=per-object SSS, and folds static shadowing.

IntegrateBxDF at 392/402/404 returns FDirectLighting; the specular helper returns (D * Vis) * F with the 1/(4 NoL NoV) folded into Vis (ShadingModels.ush:164-190), so a second textbook denominator is a different BRDF.
DiffuseScale/SpecularScale are applied after the integral at 408-410; MaskedLightColor * Shadow.SurfaceShadow is applied at 416.
Header marks AccumulateDynamicLighting/GetDynamicLighting deprecated by Substrate 5.7; the capture uses the legacy GBuffer route (r.Substrate=0).

anchors.contract: The VSM projection writes sqrt-encoded attenuation; deferred lighting squares it on read. The captured (c/255)^2 is exact for the sun's red channel, not a general scalar decode.
facts: EncodeLightAttenuation = sqrt(InColor) (1195-1206). DecodeLightAttenuation = Square(InColor) (1209-1218).
GetPerPixelLightAttenuation samples LightAttenuationTexture and applies DecodeLightAttenuation (1321-1323).
VirtualShadowMapProjectionComposite.usf:36-41 writes OutShadowMask via EncodeLightAttenuation, so the stored target is already sqrt-encoded.
LightRendering.cpp:2810-2811 binds ShadowMaskTexture as Out.LightAttenuationTexture.
LightAttenuation is a packed half4; for the captured directional sun R carries the whole-scene shadow and G agrees; B/A are clear white.

anchors.contract: Mark pages, build physical allocations, render Nanite or non-Nanite page depth, then post-render. BuildPageAllocations depends on the BeginMarkPages context.
facts: BeginMarkVirtualShadowMapPages -> BeginMarkPages at 879.
RenderVirtualShadowMaps -> BuildPageAllocations at 898, then the render overload at 904.
The render body calls RenderVirtualShadowMapsNanite at 780 or RenderVirtualShadowMapsNonNanite at 791, then PostRender at 794.
VirtualShadowMapArray.cpp:3235-3239 early-outs when there are no shadow maps; 3240-3244 ensures VirtualShadowMapSetupContext and comments that BeginMarkPages was not run.
This is orchestration evidence, not a per-page residency or timing measurement.

anchors.contract: Local-light and directional-clipmap projection entries both create a mask texture, run the common projection against a light proxy plus VSM id, then composite to OutputShadowMaskTexture.
facts: Local-light overload at 574-610 passes LightSceneInfo.Proxy and VirtualShadowMapId; composite uses bDirectionalLight=false, bModulateRGB=false.
Directional clipmap overload at 612-651 passes Clipmap->GetLightSceneInfo().Proxy and Clipmap->GetVirtualShadowMapId(); composite uses bDirectionalLight=true and forwards bModulateRGB.
RenderVirtualShadowMapProjectionCommon chooses bOnePassProjection = LightProxy == nullptr (365); one-pass writes OutShadowMaskBits (373), per-light writes OutShadowFactor (383).
CompositeVirtualShadowMapMask writes the output mask; the composite PS then applies EncodeLightAttenuation (sqrt).

anchors.contract: Per-8x8-tile reflection classification sets LUMEN_TILE_BITMASK_REFLECTIONS through NeedRayTracedReflections, which is the roughness/fade gate.
facts: The Lumen bitmask is written to RWLumenTileBitmask at 755; LUMEN_TILE_BITMASK_REFLECTIONS is 0x08 (LumenScreenProbeTileClassication.ush:10).

NeedRayTracedReflections(Material.Roughness, Material) at 590 calls NeedsLumenReflections -> LumenCombineReflectionsAlpha = saturate((MaxRoughnessToTrace - r) * InvRoughnessFadeLength) (LumenReflectionCommon.ush:325-343; LumenReflectionsCombine.ush:12-16).
ApplySmoothBias is applied before the test (589). Default smooth bias 0; default LumenMaxRoughnessToTraceReflections 0.4 (Scene.cpp:658); default fade length 0.1 (LumenReflections.cpp:129).
r.Lumen.Reflections.MaxRoughnessToTrace defaults to -1 (override disabled), but run-lumen.json sets it to 0.4.
Downstream ReflectionTileClassificationBuildListsCS scans the bitmask and builds the indirect tile lists (LumenReflections.usf:84-105,141-177).

anchors.contract: Generate rays writes direction plus packed cone/PDF only; it does not write a BRDF throughput. Screen trace runs first, then compaction selects misses or hit-lighting hits, then the world representation is chosen.
facts: Mirror branch: reflect(CameraVector, Material.WorldNormal) at 366-369. Rough branch: ImportanceSampleVisibleGGX(E, Alpha, TangentV) at 384; ConeAngle = 1/max(GGXSample.w, 1e-4) at 387.
Only RWRayBuffer = float4(RayDirection, PackedConeAngle) at 394 and RWRayTraceDistance at 416 are written. Invalid receivers mark the depth negative at 420-422.

GenerateRandom applies E.y *= 1 - GGXSamplingBias at 292; default GGXSamplingBias 0.1 (LumenReflections.cpp:137-143). ImportanceSampleVisibleGGX maps E.y into the VNDF Z and returns VisibleGGXPDF_aniso (MonteCarlo.ush:442-471); the biased sample density is not the returned PDF, and no separate correction is visible.
RWTraceThroughput is initialized to 1 by ReflectionClearTracesCS (LumenReflectionTracing.usf:52-54) and is not written by generate.
GetRayData reconstructs PDF = 1/abs(PackedRayData.w) from the cone angle (LumenReflectionCommon.ush:135-145).

Screen trace writes TraceHit with a hit bit (LumenReflectionTracing.usf:70-229). Default/far-field compaction accepts !bHit; hit-lighting compaction accepts bHit && MaterialId.bNeedsHitLightingPass (328-344).

C++ routing: hardware entry RenderLumenHardwareRayTracingReflections at LumenReflectionTracing.cpp:1258-1275; otherwise MeshSDF/heightfields at 1301-1343, then voxels/global SDF at 1349-1407. Shader entries: ReflectionTraceMeshSDFsCS (693-707) and ReflectionTraceVoxelsCS (888-902).
Captured C has screen traces on, hardware RT on, lighting mode 0 (SurfaceCache), hit lighting 0, far field 0; no per-ray data is captured.

anchors.contract: SurfaceCache hit returns cached radiance; incomplete/forced hits are flagged for a second hit-lighting pass. Sky applies only on a miss; a skylight-leak term is always added. Reflection captures are a hit-lighting context flag.
facts: Default/far-field branches call TraceSurfaceCacheRay (238) or TraceSurfaceCacheFarFieldRay (242).
bNeedsHitLightingPass = Result.bIsHit && (HitLightingForceEnabled || !Result.bIsRadianceCompleted) at 289-292; a successful SampleSceneColorAtHit cancels it at 294-302.
A near-field miss with valid radiance-cache coverage samples the cache, sets Result.bIsHit=true and cancels hit lighting at 357-366.
Hit-lighting branch uses TraceAndCalculateRayTracedLighting with bHitLightingDirectLighting, bHitLightingSkylight, bUseReflectionCaptures, force opaque, and shadow modes at 216-234.
Sky is applied only when ApplySkyLight != 0 and !Result.bIsHit (370-373); GetSkylightLeakingForReflections is added unconditionally at 375.
MaxRayIntensity clamps final pre-exposed lighting at 378-388; it is a firefly control, not a physical cap.
TraceMaterialId packs bNeedsHitLightingPass for the second pass at 399.

EHitLightingMode: SurfaceCache=0, HitLighting=1, HitLightingForReflections=2 (LumenHardwareRayTracingCommon.h:32-39); GetHitLightingMode clamps and returns 0 when ray-gen is unavailable (LumenHardwareRayTracingCommon.cpp:241-277). Captured C is mode 0.

anchors.contract: Resolve applies D_GGX/RayPDF per sample and normalizes by WeightSum; spatial filtering uses roughness-scaled kernel/lobe and depth/normal/luminance weights; temporal invalidation uses depth/distance and neighborhood consistency. The explicit normal/roughness lobe test is compiled out.
facts: GetSampleWeight returns D_GGX(a2, H.z) / RayPDF (57-73); it is not the full D*Vis*F BRDF.
The weight is applied to the center sample at 466-476 and to neighbor samples at 542-575, then normalized by WeightSum at 620-630.
RWSpecularIndirect = Center.Lighting and RWSpecularIndirectDepth = Center.MinRayHitT at 649-653; view-pre-exposed, still missing EnvBRDF.
Spatial kernel radius = SpatialFilterKernelRadius * saturate(roughness*8) at DenoiserSpatial:92; LobeHalfAngle = GetSpecularLobeHalfAngle(roughness) at 109.
Spatial weights: plane-distance/relative-depth Gaussian (125-129) * normal (1-angle/LobeHalfAngle, 131-133) * luminance (138-142). No explicit roughness-delta weight.
Temporal surface path: DisocclusionDistanceThreshold = HistoryDistanceThreshold * lerp(0.5,1.5,noise) (178); relative depth select (224-225); grazing-angle widening (217-220).
REFLECT_HIT_DEPTH_TEST is 0 (183), so the hit-history plane test is compiled out.
LOBE_CONFIDENCE is 0 (422), so the normal/roughness lobe block at 425-439 is dead in this build.
Active reuse reduction: IsLightingValid (243-248), depth/distance rejection, neighborhood clamp (492-493), hit-vs-surface choice by neighborhood error (495-507), confidence floor 0.75*C+0.25 (534).

Roughness still selects max history frames: MaxFramesAccumulated = lerp(2, MaxFramesAccumulated, saturate(roughness/0.05)) for 1x downsample (410-413); final alpha = 1/(N + 4 if reconstructed) (543-545).
Composition: MixSpecularAndRoughReflections does Rough*(1-alpha)+Traced*alpha at DiffuseIndirectComposite:227-244; CombineRoughSpecular multiplies by EnvBRDF at 246-258.
